V42-AP-001.ban: PubSub-as-truth is forbidden; persist first and publish as a side effect.

V42-AP-002.ban: GenServer locks as correctness truth are forbidden (no global mutex-as-truth).

V42-AP-004.ban: authorize?: false shortcuts outside audited system flows are forbidden.

V42-AP-005.consequence: Account takeover risk; violates IAM-3 invariants.
V42-AP-005.description: Treating SMS or email OTP as step-up assurance (AAL2) is forbidden. Only strong possession factors (TOTP, WebAuthn hardware keys) may satisfy requires_strong_assurance: aal2_strong.
V42-AP-005.title: AAL2 via SMS/Email OTP

V42-AP-006.consequence: DB leak becomes total auth bypass.
V42-AP-006.description: Persisting TOTP seeds, recovery codes, or any MFA secret material in plaintext is forbidden.
V42-AP-006.title: Plaintext MFA secrets

V42-AP-007.description: Issuing step-up proof not structurally bound to (actor_id, session_id) is forbidden. Grants must not be reusable across sessions.
V42-AP-007.title: Unbound StepUpGrant

V42-AP-008.consequence: Online brute force of 6-digit TOTP becomes feasible.
V42-AP-008.description: Allowing infinite retries for TOTP/WebAuthn verification is forbidden. Rate limits and lockouts are mandatory.
V42-AP-008.title: Unlimited MFA retries

compliance_definition.claim_rule: An implementation MUST NOT claim V42 compliance unless every required governed subsystem contract is present at or above minimum versions and the enforcement hooks defined herein are satisfied.

Tenancy mechanics (tenant injection, RLS, global exceptions).
Canonical errors and retry taxonomy.
Ledger truth, payouts, reserves, disputes.
Seating/holds/anti-oversell.
Pricing/snapshots/fees/promos/tax posture.
Orders/idempotency/payment boundaries/fulfillment.
Performance + admission control (waiting room) budgets.

Bootstrap access (invites/magic links) separated from MFA to reduce blast radius.

V42-FIN-001.assertion: Platform is Merchant of Record; organizers receive payouts derived from immutable ledger entries.

V42-FIN-002.assertion: All money movement MUST be represented in a ledger-grade, immutable, double-entry model.

V42-FIN-003.assertion: Ledger postings MUST reconcile to order price snapshot totals; discrepancies block payout release.

runtime: LED-1 atomic posting verifies snapshot reconciliation
tests: negative tests deny payout when ledger ≠ snapshot

V42-GOV-001.assertion: Required governed subsystem contracts MUST be present at or above minimum versions for any V42 compliance claim.

V42-GOV-002.assertion: V42 MUST remain constitutional; feature specifics live only in governed subsystem contracts; deferred scope MUST be tracked in FR-1 (no stealth features).

V42-IAM-001.assertion: All authorization decisions MUST evaluate an auth_context containing (actor_id, session_id, org_id?) and assurance_level (aal1|aal2_strong|aal3). Capability checks MUST enforce any min_assurance requirements for high-risk actions.

verification: assurance policy table maps capabilities to min_assurance

V42-IAM-002.assertion: MFA secrets MUST NEVER be stored in plaintext. TOTP seeds MUST be envelope-encrypted. Recovery codes MUST be stored as one-way hashes and MUST be single-use.

verification: IAM-3 factor resources mark secret material as encrypted/hashed

V42-IAM-003.assertion: An MFA factor MUST NOT transition to active until a successful verification ceremony has completed (no zombie factors).

V42-IAM-004.assertion: Step-up proof MUST be session-bound. A StepUpGrant issued for (actor_id, session_id) MUST NOT satisfy assurance checks in any other session.

verification: StepUpGrant includes actor_id + session_id and is checked on every privileged action

V42-IAM-005.assertion: SMS and Email OTP are forbidden as AAL2 step-up factors. They may be used for notifications or AAL1 bootstrap only, but never to satisfy requires_strong_assurance: aal2_strong.

verification: IAM-3 allowed_factors excludes sms/email for step-up

V42-IAM-005.text: Consumer OTP (SMS/Email) MAY exist only as IAM-2 consumer_proof and MUST NOT satisfy strong assurance.

V42-IAM-006.assertion: MFA verification endpoints MUST enforce attempt limits and lockouts (no infinite retries). Exceeding max_attempts MUST trigger lockout_duration and/or a hard lock until recovery.

verification: IAM-3 rate_limit_policy exists and is enforced on verify actions

V42-IAM-010.text: Assurance comparisons MUST NOT be written as ordered comparisons (e.g., '>= aal2'). Policies MUST use explicit, named checks: requires_strong_assurance: aal2_strong OR requires_consumer_proof: true.

V42-IAM-011.text: Factor Independence: If an identifier/channel (e.g., email inbox) is used as the sole AAL1 login channel, it MUST NOT be the sole recovery channel for IAM-3 strong assurance. Compromise of one channel MUST NOT collapse both AAL1 and aal2_strong.

V42-IAM-012.text: Passkey Ambiguity Guard: WebAuthn passkeys enrolled via IAM-2 (consumer convenience) MUST NOT mint IAM-3 step-up grants and MUST NOT satisfy aal2_strong. Only IAM-3 enrolled admin-grade factors may satisfy requires_strong_assurance: aal2_strong.

V42-INV-001.assertion: Seat inventory is the authoritative truth source. Hold, allocate, and release semantics are governed by SEAT-1 with exclusive locking, TTL expiration, and atomic state transitions enforced via RLS, unique constraints, and Ash action gates.

ci: SEAT-1 test gates enforce hold exclusivity
runtime: RLS policies prevent cross-tenant seat access
tests: negative tests deny concurrent allocation of same seat

V42-OPS-001.assertion: Admission control MUST exist for high-load scenarios and must degrade safely (waiting room or equivalent).

tests: load scenarios must not overload critical paths

V42-OPS-002.assertion: Background execution MUST use supported job patterns with explicit budgets; 'just retry' is forbidden as a correctness strategy.

V42-PRC-001.assertion: Orders capture immutable price snapshots at checkout; pricing MUST NOT be recomputed after purchase. Snapshot signature_hash provides cryptographic binding; ledger postings MUST reconcile to snapshot totals.

runtime: DB predicate verification of signature_hash during finalization

V42-SEC-001.assertion: Authorization bypass is restricted to system-actor flows only with mandatory audit + justification; bypass shortcuts are forbidden elsewhere.

V42-TEN-001.assertion: All tenant-owned operations MUST execute with an explicit tenant context; untenanted reads/writes are forbidden by default except explicit global resources.

V42-TEN-002.assertion: Tenant isolation MUST be fail-closed and cross-tenant OLTP aggregation is forbidden (rollups/read replicas only).
